title: Principal Systems Engineer
description:
Fourth Power is developing and commercializing the lowest cost energy storage technology on the market to enable the utility grid to operate 24/7/365 on renewable energy. Our batteries store heat in low-cost carbon blocks at up to 2400 degrees Celsius – half the temperature of the sun. The batteries then convert this heat back to electricity using thermophotovoltaics (TPV) on demand.
Fourth Power has a culture of teamwork, continuous innovation based on first principles, and relentlessness in tackling challenging problems. Fourth Power is looking for highly skilled, experienced, and motivated individuals who share our passion for mitigating climate change.

Job Description
We are seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to join the Fourth Power Engineering team. You will provide cross-cutting systems engineering support across our technology development programs, ensuring requirements, interfaces, risks, and safety concerns are identified and resolved across disciplines.
This is a full-time, exempt role.
Location: Bedford, MA and Middleton, MA

Your Role

- Own system-level requirements and traceability from top-level targets down to subsystem specs across mechanical, electrical, chemical, and controls domains.

- Identify applicable codes, standards, and regulations (e.g., NEC, NFPA, ASME, OSHA) for evolving system designs and advise engineering leads on compliance.

- Lead formal risk identification and tracking (FMEA, HAZOP, fault tree, or equivalent), maintain risk registers, and drive mitigations to closure.

- Manage interface definitions between subsystems and ensure cross-discipline interactions are captured and conflicts resolved early.

- Support electrical system design reviews with practical knowledge of industrial electrical concerns including grounding, ground fault propagation, fuse coordination, protective coordination, cable routing, and power quality.

- Split time between desk-based analysis and hands-on work on the shop floor, including inspecting hardware, supporting test campaigns, and troubleshooting in a lab environment.

- Synthesize specialist inputs across knowledge domains, ask the right questions, and identify gaps where you are not the subject matter expert.

- Support design reviews, gate reviews, and test planning with structured analysis and clear acceptance criteria.

Qualifications

- 10+ years of systems engineering experience with demonstrated depth in formal requirements management, risk identification, and interface control.

- Experience in extreme environments or with first-of-kind hardware strongly preferred.

- Prior energy, power, or heavy industrial experience strongly preferred.

- Proficient as a technical generalist across mechanical, electrical, and chemical engineering disciplines.

- Proficient in independently determining which codes and standards apply to a new design context.

- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with fellow engineers and technicians.

- BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Fourth Power is committed to offering equitable compensation, stock options, and a competitive benefits package to all employees.

title: Engineering Technician
description:
Engineering Technician, Operations
Fourth Power is developing and commercializing the lowest cost energy storage technology on the market to enable the utility grid to operate 24/7/365 on renewable energy. Our batteries store heat in low-cost carbon blocks at up to 2400 degrees Celsius – half the temperature of the sun. The batteries then convert this heat back to electricity using thermophotovoltaics (TPV) on demand.
Fourth Power has a culture of teamwork, continuous innovation based on first principles, and relentlessness in tackling challenging problems. Fourth Power is looking for highly skilled, experienced, and motivated individuals who share our passion for mitigating climate change.
Job Description
We are seeking an Engineering Technician to join the Fourth Power Operations team. You will be responsible for building, operating, and maintaining Fourth Power’s development systems.
Your Role

- Execute machining, fabrication, and assembly tasks with direction from project engineers. Tasks may include fabricating parts, assembling extrusion or unistrut structures, connecting piping, and wiring instrumentation.

- Work with stakeholders to design and fabricate simple fixtures

- Work directly with engineers to assist with troubleshooting and remediation work

- Set up, operate, and break down experiments with direction of project engineers.

- Assist with equipment upkeep and maintenance

- Support engineering activities by receiving and putting away materials, maintaining workshop space, maintaining shared tools, and maintaining equipment.

Qualifications

- 5 or more years of experience in industrial equipment maintenance, mechanical assembly, or construction.

- Proficiency in a machine shop with manual and semi-automated machines such as lathes, mills, drill presses, etc.

- Proficiency with hand tools such as wrenches, screwdrivers, calipers, handsaws, powered saws, etc.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, and Microsoft Outlook.

- Experience taking a basic concept through design and fabrication.

- Experience writing procedures and other technical documentation.

- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong communication skills to collaborate with fellow engineers and technicians.

- Ability to move boxes weighing up to 25lbs regularly.

This is a full-time on-site, hourly (non-exempt) role with opportunity for overtime.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
Facilities Manager
Fourth Power is developing and commercializing the lowest cost energy storage technology on the market to enable the utility grid to operate 24/7/365 on renewable energy. Our batteries store heat in low-cost carbon blocks at up to 2400 degrees Celsius -- half the temperature of the sun. The batteries then convert this heat back to electricity using thermophotovoltaics (TPV) on demand.
Fourth Power has a culture of teamwork, continuous innovation based on first principles, and relentlessness in tackling challenging problems. Fourth Power is looking for highly skilled, experienced, and motivated individuals who share our passion for mitigating climate change.
Job Description
We are seeking a Facilities Manager to join the Fourth Power Operations team. You will be responsible for owning safe, efficient, and effective facility operations across Fourth Power's two sites.
This is a full-time, exempt role.
Location: Bedford, MA
Your Role

- Own safe, efficient, and effective facility operations at Fourth Power's two sites.

- Define and execute the facility custodial and maintenance plan with support from the engineering technician team. Negotiate and administer service contracts as required.

- Manage building general supply stock levels and procurement.

- Define and execute on team building events at our sites.

- Define and execute inbound and outbound receiving processes.

- Respond to facility failures.

- Define and manage the facilities budget.

- Lead and execute continuous improvement projects at both sites.

Qualifications

- 5 or more years of experience in facilities management, plant maintenance, or industrial operations. Experience maintaining plant cooling systems, not just general facilities HVAC a plus.

- Experience defining and executing preventive maintenance programs.

- Experience negotiating and administering facility-related service contracts.

- Experience defining and managing a facilities budget.

- Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint.

- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with fellow engineers and technicians.

- Passionate about building a great team culture.
